title: Stability inequality B.1 for smooth compactly supported test functions (second variation)
statement:
Stability inequality B.1 for smooth test functions. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; U ⊆ ℝ^P; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: those of the parent theorem — U open, M ⊆ U, dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀, M an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold for every r ∈ ℕ, H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ν C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, and for x ∈ M: ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1, ν(x)·v = 0 for v ∈ tangentSpace M x, trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0; and for every C^∞ compactly supported Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with tsupport Z ⊆ U there is t₀ > 0 with H^m(M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ H^m({x + tZ(x) : x ∈ M ∩ tsupport Z}) for |t| < t₀ — together with: (Meas) M is measurable; (hArea) for every measurable E ⊆ M and every C¹ map Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P that is injective on E with DΦ(x) injective for x ∈ E, H^m(Φ(E)) ≤ ∫⁻_E ofReal(√det((DΦ(x)ι_x)*(DΦ(x)ι_x))) dH^m(x), where ι_x is the inclusion of span(tangentSpace M x). Conclusion: for every C^∞ ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support that vanishes on M outside some compact C ⊆ M,
 ∫_M (Σ_j |Dν(x)(P_xe_j)|²)·ζ(x)² dH^m(x) ≤ ∫_M Σ_j (Dζ(x)(P_xe_j))² dH^m(x),
with P_x the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, D = fderiv ℝ, H^m = μHE[m], Bochner integrals over M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ ν x).toLinearMap) = 0) → (∀ Z : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Z → HasCompactSupport Z → tsupport Z ⊆ U → ∃ t₀ : ℝ, 0 < t₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < t₀ → μHE[m] (M ∩ tsupport Z) ≤ μHE[m] ((fun x => x + t • Z x) '' (M ∩ tsupport Z))) → (∀ (E : Set (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → InjOn Φ E → (∀ x ∈ E, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → μHE[m] (Φ '' E) ≤ ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL)).det)) ∂μHE[m]) → ∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∫ x in M, (∑ j : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))‖ ^ 2) * ζ x ^ 2 ∂μHE[m] ≤ ∫ x in M, ∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ ζ x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2 ∂μHE[m]
